name: Dodo Payments

evidence.mor: F02: authorized reseller and legal seller to the buyer; Dodo handles payment and sales tax
evidence.billing: F14: automatic recurring billing on cards and wallets; F15: trials, seats, usage and retries
evidence.links: F16: reusable payment links and a hosted no-code storefront are documented
evidence.crypto: C01: buyers can pay in USDC on listed networks; C03: merchant is paid in USD

line: Merchant of Record checkout and billing for digital products.

free.text: No monthly fee stated; transaction fees apply

cells.payout: Twice monthly by default; contract terms conflict

fee.math: The pricing page and docs say 4% plus $0.40. The contract terms (the MSA) say 5% plus $0.50.
UK sellers are accepted, but no UK card rate is listed on the pricing schedule.
German sellers are accepted, but no German card rate is listed on the pricing schedule.
The published India rate says 4% plus 15 cents. Fees for international payments also apply.
